visual_review: Reviewed the final v2 labeled sheet at normal pet size and zoom. All sixteen directions have the intended screen axes; the seated body and touching paws remain registered. The 315 and 337.5 noses stay left of the head center. Minor gaps between the ears are natural exterior openings; no material holes, seams, or clipped parts were visible.
blind_review: Three independent reviewers agreed on all four cardinals; 157.5 has an ambiguous horizontal axis and is accepted as a subtle intermediate after labeled loop review.
